aluminium-stock-management.overview: A production-grade inventory and manufacturing workflow system for aluminium section factories. It digitises the journey from raw aluminium waste to finished section bundles and dispatch, using barcode-driven bundle management and real-time inventory updates.
highlights: Bundle management: create bundles, generate Code 128 barcodes, print and reprint labels, track Produced or Dispatched status
Inventory: real-time stock, section-wise and bundle-wise tracking, production versus dispatch reconciliation
Dispatch: dispatch processing, history and date-filtered reports
Reporting: daily, monthly and custom-range reports with a dashboard of operational KPIs
aluminium-stock-management.challenge: Factories often track production bundles and dispatch records in manual registers or Excel sheets. That leads to stock mismatches, calculation errors, poor transparency and difficulty tracing where a bundle went. The aim was a structured, reliable and scalable system for accurate stock tracking and operational visibility.

brokersnet.overview: BrokersNet is a real estate marketplace and PropTech platform for property discovery by buyers and brokers, inspired by Housing.com. It combines a configurable backend, map-based search and Android and iOS apps.
highlights: Backend-driven property listings, with most settings controlled from an admin panel
Admin control of property registration, listing categories, rent and resale filters, amenities, tags and form fields without code changes
Filters for location, property type, budget, amenities and more
Android and iOS apps with a consistent experience

images.caption: Broker dashboard with available, rented and sold properties
Map search with property pins, type filters and listing preview

workflow: Admins configure the platform through the backend, so markets and brokers can be adapted without code changes
Users explore properties on an interactive map and narrow results with backend-controlled filters
Buyers browse Rent and Resale listings; brokers manage listings from their phones
